Package org.lightsleep.logger

Interface Logger

All Known Implementing Classes:
Jdk, Log4j, Log4j2, SLF4J, Std, Std.Err, Std.Err.Debug, Std.Err.Error, Std.Err.Fatal, Std.Err.Info, Std.Err.Trace, Std.Err.Warn, Std.Out, Std.Out.Debug, Std.Out.Error, Std.Out.Fatal, Std.Out.Info, Std.Out.Trace, Std.Out.Warn
public interface Logger
An interface to perform the log output. It is used internally to ensure that does not depend on specific logger libraries.
Since:
1.0.0
Author:
Masato Kokubo
